name: Clover-35B-A3B Preview

lineage.how_derived: converted to a block-diffusion language model with bidirectional block attention via extra learned GDN parameters

purpose: First DiffuSpace model: state-of-the-art open diffusion language model at release on the vendor's reported benchmarks, decoding blocks of tokens in parallel (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: block-diffusion LM on a hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention MoE
architecture.attention: hybrid GDN / full attention; bidirectional within a 32-token block, causal prefix
architecture.drafter: self-speculative decoding (own SGLang and llama.cpp implementations)

variants.notes: about 69 GB per the card; no quant checked

pc-12gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
pc-12gb.notes: 22 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~None B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
pc-16gb.notes: 22 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~None B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
pc-24gb.notes: 22 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~None B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
pc-32gb.notes: 22 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
mac-16-24gb.notes: 22 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
mac-32gb.notes: 22 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (22 GB); no quant published
mac-64gb+.notes: 22 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: own llama.cpp implementation in the vendor repo
engine_support.notes: Diffusion decoding is not in upstream llama.cpp.

strengths: parallel block decoding aimed at faster generation
weaknesses: benchmarks only on the vendor blog (not opened); preview

tona_fit.reason: Diffusion LMs trade per-token cost for parallel blocks; for our bandwidth-bound decode the gain would only show if the expert reads amortize over a block. Interesting research item, not an offer.
blockers: diffusion decoding not supported by common engines

open_questions: blog benchmarks and speed on a memory-bound GPU
